Hi Sara — thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. Looping in Grace (Sales Ops) and Tessa (Finance Ops) who will own the portal handoff and PO acceptance. High-level answers below and next steps in the attachment.

1) Procurement portal flow: Redwood's portal supports vendor recertification as a three-step submission (legal -> security evidence -> procurement terms). We typically accept the vendor questionnaire in the "security evidence" stage and then a final PO in the procurement stage. I'll attach a short mutual action plan that maps Nimbus' questionnaire fields to the portal sections.

2) Phased PO: We can accept an initial committed PO with a scheduled amendment for capacity top-ups. That path requires a short amendment (signed) and an internal EWA (evidence of work authorization) entry in the portal so Finance can match invoices. It is the recommended approach for staged rollouts.

Next steps (short):
- I uploaded a mutual action plan mapping to our portal (see attachment mutual_action_plan.xlsx).
- Grace to create a vendor recert ticket in the portal and invite Nimbus to the secure evidence upload slot.
- Tessa will confirm billing cadence and whether the initial PO can be applied as a credit toward the top-up amendment.

Can you confirm who at Nimbus will be uploading the questionnaire and whether they prefer a shared Drive folder or DocuSign for the PO?

Thanks,

Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
